split_policy: Only overlong original bodies; pack complete paragraphs; oversized tables or indivisible paragraphs remain atomic and explicitly flagged; no character cutting or overlap
parent_policy: Group originals by document_id and first two section_path levels; preserve member order and individual source references
dense_search: Exact cosine over original normalized float32 vectors and independently encoded children; same backend for both controls; not a Chroma/HNSW performance comparison
budget_accounting: Sum of tokenizer counts of each serialized context with two trailing newlines; whole contexts only, skip over-budget contexts, no truncation
warmup_question: 请检索足球球门尺寸及场地边界相关资料。
selection: Development conservative budgeted MRR@10, Recall@5, Recall@10 descending; mean context tokens ascending; method order
quality_policy: An original labelled unit counts as covered only when union of returned source character spans covers its entire body. No inferred child-level relevance labels. Expanded parent metrics must be accompanied by seed metrics and context size.
